items.title: Two papers accepted in Structure and Journal of Structural Biology
items.body: Morphotype-resolved 3D morphometry of mitochondrial networks accepted in Structure, and robust mitochondria segmentation with soft X-ray tomography published in the Journal of Structural Biology.

items.title: Divyanshu Bathla awarded the IndiaAI PhD Fellowship
items.body: Divyanshu Bathla, a doctoral student in the lab, has received the IndiaAI PhD Fellowship. A national initiative under the IndiaAI Mission, it supports full-time doctoral researchers in AI with a monthly stipend of ₹70,000–80,000, an annual research grant of ₹2 lakh, and conference travel support of up to ₹1 lakh.

items.title: Interaction with participants at MMTTC, HNB Garhwal University
items.body: Prof. Parikshit Pareek and Jitin Singla engaged with attendees at MMTTC as part of a Faculty Development Programme on “Harnessing AI in Higher Education for an Innovative Future”.

items.title: Capacity Building Workshop at SCOPE, IIT Kharagpur
items.body: A five-day workshop on Science Communication, Outreach & Public Engagement.

items.title: Computational Biology Conference 2025, RCB Faridabad
items.body: Attended the inaugural Computational Biology Conference in Bharat at the Regional Centre for Biotechnology, Faridabad — including a discussion of the tetrahedral visual design language for macromolecules with Prof. Joel L. Sussman.

items.title: Hands-on workshop on AI/ML applications
items.body: Led instruction on classification techniques in a three-day workshop jointly organised by HRDD, PPEG and the AI/ML Peer Group for scientists and engineers at URSC.

items.title: Visiting Professor at USC
items.body: Served as Visiting Professor at the University of Southern California, collaborating with Prof. Helen Berman and Prof. Kate White, with visits to Rutgers University and UCLA.

items.title: Lab opens at IIT Roorkee
items.body: Commenced as Assistant Professor in the Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering, IIT Roorkee.

items.title: BEYOND Conference 2020
items.body: Panel participation — “Emergence: World in a Cell, an Artscience Collaboration”.
